WITH grouped_invoices AS (
  SELECT 
    BillingState,
    COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoice
  GROUP BY BillingState
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices,
    AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_count
  FROM grouped_invoices
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT
    gi.invoice_count,
    s.total_invoices,
    s.avg_count,
    gi.invoice_count / s.total_invoices AS share
  FROM grouped_invoices gi
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE gi.invoice_count > s.avg_count
)
SELECT
  SUM(invoice_count) AS total_in_above_avg_groups,
  AVG(share) AS avg_share,
  AVG(invoice_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess_count
FROM filtered_groups;

assumptions.assumption: The average count per group used as a threshold is calculated across all groups (before filtering), not just the filtered groups
NULL BillingState values are treated as a single group and included in all calculations
